status: SOP-grounded demo design; implementation and verification reported separately
scope: Product-led project through sample, quotation, PO review, confirmation and release handoff

designDecision.selected: Bounded single-material project aggregate, immutable review snapshots, append-only history and idempotent operation receipts
designDecision.alternative: Separate tables for every sample, quotation, purchase order, review, release and handoff
designDecision.reason: Keep this demo's consistency rules in transactional commands while preserving distinct commercial, review and handoff state
designDecision.independentReview: Read-only design comparison favored the aggregate for bounded implementation; required versioned commercial evidence and stable release identities
